summary.text: Nate Roberts is the Democratic candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 29B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Jennifer Miles.
An electrician by trade, he previously represented District 29B from 2022 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Nate Roberts was born in Coos Bay, Oregon.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as an electrician and construction professional on industrial, commercial and residential projects, and as recording secretary and registrar at IBEW Local 449.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he had more than 30 years of experience in the electrical and construction trades and had taught at the College of Southern Idaho.
Roberts won the District 29B seat in the 2022 general election, defeating Republican Jake Stevens 50.4 percent to 49.6 percent.
During the 2023-2024 term he was assigned to committees including Agricultural Affairs, Commerce and Human Resources, Health and Welfare, and State Affairs.
He lost re-election in 2024 to Republican Tanya Burgoyne, 47.4 percent to 52.6 percent.
In his 2022 survey responses, Roberts listed bodily autonomy, funding for public education, property taxes and affordable housing as his key messages.
